title: Rewrite edit_meeting_screen.dart to new design system
instructions:
Rewrite lib/ui/meetings/editMeeting/widgets/edit_meeting_screen.dart using the new design system primitives. Pattern: FORM (prefilled) + DROPDOWN.

**Cubit (DO NOT MODIFY):** EditMeetingCubit(meetingsRepository) is already wired in lib/routing/router.dart. Constructor signature MUST stay identical.

**States:** EditMeetingInitial / EditMeetingLoading / EditMeetingLoaded(meeting, availableBlocks, selectedBlock) / EditMeetingError(message). Cubit loads meeting then exposes update + reload flow.

**Widgets to use:** AppAppBar(title: 'Editar reunião'), AppCard (wrapping the form), AppTextField (title, date/time, location), AppDropdown<CarnivalBlocksEntity> (block selection - pre-select with current meeting.blockId), AppButton(label: 'Salvar alterações', isFullWidth: true), AppSnackbar.

**Layout guidance:**
1. AppAppBar with title 'Editar reunião', showBackButton: true.
2. Body: SingleChildScrollView > AppCard with the form.
3. While state is initial/loading, show AppLoading on the AppAppBar level (full-screen).
4. When state is EditMeetingLoaded, render the form fields prefilled:
   - AppDropdown<CarnivalBlocksEntity>(label: 'Bloco', value: state.selectedBlock, items: state.availableBlocks.map((b) => AppDropdownItem(value: b, label: b.name)).toList(), onChanged: cubit.selectBlock). If only 1 block, skip the dropdown per existing UX.
   - AppTextField(label: 'Título da reunião', controller pre-populated with state.meeting.title)
   - AppTextField(label: 'Data e hora', readOnly: true, suffixIcon: Icons.event_rounded, controller pre-populated with DateFormat.yMd('pt_BR').add_Hm().format(state.meeting.meetingDateTime), onTap: showDatePicker+TimePicker)
   - AppTextField(label: 'Local', controller pre-populated with state.meeting.location)
5. AppButton at bottom - label 'Salvar alterações', isLoading when state.status == loading; isDisabled when required fields empty OR unchanged.
6. On submit success: AppSnackbar.success('Reunião atualizada com sucesso'), call cubit.loadMeeting() (refresh), then context.pop().
7. On submit failure: AppSnackbar.error with user-friendly pt-BR message (refer to .opencode/context/project-intelligence/guides/error-to-user-message.md).

**Preserve exactly:** constructor signature, cubit API (updateMeeting + loadMeeting + selectBlock), all pt-BR strings, the prefilled initial value pattern.
validation: All string literals use double quotes
Screen widget class name `EditMeetingScreen` and constructor `const EditMeetingScreen({super.key})` preserved
NO emojis as icons - Material Symbols Rounded only
AppTextField for date/time is readOnly with suffixIcon: Icons.event_rounded and onTap opens DatePicker + TimePicker
Title/date/location controllers prefilled from state.meeting on EditMeetingLoaded
On submit success: AppSnackbar.success + cubit.loadMeeting() (refresh) + context.pop()
On submit failure: AppSnackbar.error with user-friendly pt-BR message
